subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep pursuing this PR's exit-0 healthy-probe design after v2026.6.11 shipped the systemd exit-78 restart-loop fix?
rationale: The central systemd restart-loop is already solved by shipped code, while this branch changes gateway startup and trusted-proxy auth-boundary behavior under a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Confirm the shipped exit-78 behavior is the intended contract and close this conflicted branch instead of reviving the exit-0 probe design.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebase that keeps only a remaining authenticated-probe gap, fixes trusted-proxy source validation and IPv6 URLs, removes unrelated churn, and adds real supervisor proof.

options.title: Accept Probe Semantics
options.body: Explicitly choose exit-0 probe semantics despite compatibility and auth-boundary tradeoffs, then require upgrade and live behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Confirm the shipped exit-78 behavior is the intended contract and close this conflicted branch instead of reviving the exit-0 probe design.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the shipped systemd EADDRINUSE fix that this PR now competes with.
